model_architecture: EEGCNNTransformer (1D Temporal/Spatial Conv + 4-Head Transformer Encoder + Attentive Subject Pooler)

unconstrained_evaluation.description: Full held-out test set evaluated with threshold = 0.50 (no uncertainty rejection)

uncertainty_gated_evaluation.description: Held-out test set evaluated with uncertainty threshold = 0.65

confusion_matrix_on_accepted.discrepancy_explanation: The confusion matrix sum of 21 represents the accepted/covered test participants under threshold 0.65. The remaining 4 participants (ASEEG_SZ_40, ASEEG_HC_24, ASEEG_HC_29, ASEEG_HC_23) were flagged as UNCERTAIN due to low confidence margins (< 0.65) and withheld from forced binary assignment, giving 21 accepted + 4 uncertain = 25 total test participants.
